metadata.title: GUI-0102: The regulations
metadata.legal_basis: Health Canada administrative guidance interpreting the Food and Drug Regulations; the chapter title does not make this guidance legislation. Read the current legal provisions.
metadata.applicability: Manufacturers and market authorization holders with in-scope marketed human drugs. This is one chapter, not the entire guideline. Read the overview, system chapter and qualifications.

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.
